messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated tail latency and error rate on streaming responses (us-west-2). Auto-paging oncall. metrics: tail_latency p95->p99 jump, SSE errors x5. paging: @jen_oncall
jen_oncall: I'm on it, looking at dashboards now. starting a quick triage.
alex_sre: grabbing logs and connection stats. seems like sudden spike of long-running streams plus KV cache thrash. QPS up ~3x from expected baseline.
maria_prod: support is seeing a lot of "stalled_stream" events from client SDKs. customers reporting partial responses. I'll surface top 5 affected accounts.
ryan_support: prepping customer comms. Suggested short note: "We're investigating degraded streaming responses; as a temporary measure we'll switch impacted tiers to polling while we stabilize." Want approval to send to free/standard customers.
jen_oncall: Proposal to mitigate quickly: disable streaming (SSE/push) for non-enterprise customers in us-west-2 and apply temporary rate-limits on /v1/streams. Keep enterprise and Dedicated on streaming. Anyone object? :thinking_face:
alex_sre: agree. I can flip the feature flag and apply a per-ORG rate-limit. Plan:
```bash
# toggle streaming for tiers
POST https://config-service/api/v1/flags/streaming
Payload: {"region":"us-west-2","tiers":["free","standard"],"enabled":false}
# update gateway rate limit
PATCH https://gw-config/api/limits -d '{"path":"/v1/streams","limit_per_org":50,"max_connections":5000}'
```
jen_oncall: Good. Maria, Ryan - prepare the status page + customer note. Alex, do you need help with the rollout?
maria_prod: Status page draft up, will publish once mitigation in place. Also pinging account execs for any enterprise risk (they should remain unaffected).
ryan_support: Sending customer note to affected list now. Template uses: "We have temporarily disabled streaming for your plan to stabilize latency. You can continue to poll for completions via the API. We're monitoring and will restore as soon as safe."
ops-bot: action:deploy-started by alex_sre on config-service (v2.14) — change: streaming.enabled=false for tiers free,standard in us-west-2
alex_sre: Flip complete. Verified config: `streaming.enabled: false` for free/standard in us-west-2 via `kubectl -n platform get config config-service -o yaml`. Gateway rate limit patched.
jen_oncall: Observability update: within 2 minutes p99 latency down ~30%, errors trending back to baseline. Connection pool normalized. Keeping 30m heightened watch.
maria_prod: Published status page update and customer emails sent. No enterprise customers impacted.
ryan_support: Support queue: 12 tickets opened, triage assigned, sending follow-ups to any account with persistent issues.
jen_oncall: Logging mitigation actions in PD incident. Handoff plan: I'll hand to night oncall in 40m if metrics stable. Leave notes in #incidents/streaming-mitigation and the incident doc.
alex_sre: Recorded runbook entry for toggling: action=feature-flag-toggle, actor=alex_sre, scope=us-west-2, tiers=free/standard, timestamp=3127770000. Snapshot uploaded.
ops-bot: snapshot saved -> s3://redwood-incident-snapshots/3127770000/snapshot.json
jen_oncall: Thanks all. We'll reopen if we see regression. Final ask to SRE: follow-up postmortem + root cause calc (KV cache pressure vs client behavior). :white_check_mark:
jen_oncall: Closing Slack thread; continuing incident bridge for deeper debugging and postmortem planning.
